summary: Updates never change the database while a PIM job is running.

fixes.title: Updates never interrupt a running job
fixes.text: The updater waits up to 20 minutes for running PIM jobs. If they are still running, it waits for a later run and changes nothing.

fixes.title: Build pool idle between builds
fixes.text: A private installation's build pool sits at zero between builds and scales up only for a build.
